base.head: skull/head.blend
base.note: v8_clips.glb = the v6 base body (tee + shorts + default hair) with every clip, and the v8 head: a rounded head with a flat face area on the shared skull (head fit). Sit/Study sit on a seat at seatHeight; Sleep/Defeat lie on the back with the head toward the character's back (+Y Blender, -Z glTF). hand = the socket that holds the weapon.

verbs.note: The verb library (classes v2, design sheet 1.8): the rig and its actions only, loaded in the ruins. impact = phase of the hit key; upper = can play on the upper body; hold = the phase span a held verb loops.

hairMaps.note: Round 2 (David, 2026-10-17): each hairstyle's own source texture, one cell a piece (hair/import_hair.py natural_map): RGB as drawn in Roblox (sRGB), alpha its recolour channel (1 the hair's colour, 2/3 its second colour, 1/3 fixed). A part's map names its cell and each channel's median [L, C, h] (OKLCh); a picked colour turns and scales the texels' chroma so the median lands on it, every texel keeping its lightness (look.ts hairShift, Character.tsx). u < 0 (the under-cap) takes the colour of the hair's median, darkened by its COLOR_0.

staff.note: The sushi bar's staff at work (game/sushi-bar): the rig and its actions only, loaded by the bar's chef and server.
